screen.infinitestats.hint_controls: Allocate stat points in the GUI to empower your character
screen.infinitestats.title: Infinite Stats System
screen.infinitestats.debuff_filter.hint_: Blacklist: listed effects will be blocked
Whitelist: listed effects will never be blocked
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.haste: Increases mining and attack speed (+20% per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.strength: Increases melee attack damage (+3 per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.instant_d: Instantly deals damage (6 per level); heals undead instead
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.jump_boos: Increases jump height (+1 block per level) and reduces fall damage
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.nausea: Warps the screen and sways the view
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.fire_resi: Immune to fire, lava and melting damage
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.invisibil: Hides the body, but armor and particles stay visible
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.blindness: Darkens the view; prevents sprinting and critical hits
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.weakness: Reduces melee attack damage (-4 per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.poison: Drains health over time, but never kills (1 per 1.25s)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.wither: Drains health over time and can kill (1 per 2s)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.absorptio: Grants extra absorption shield (+4 per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.glowing: Outlines the entity, visible through blocks
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.levitatio: Floats upward; cannot descend on purpose
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.luck: Improves loot and fishing quality (+1 per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.unluck: Worsens loot and fishing quality (-1 per level)
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.slow_fall: Greatly slows falling and prevents fall damage
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.conduit_p: Grants underwater night vision and haste, and attacks nearby hostile mobs
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.bad_omen: Triggers a raid when entering a village
infinitestats.effect.minecraft.hero_of_t: Villager trades are discounted and villagers throw gifts
stat.infinitestats.absorption_shield.des: Gain bonus absorption health as a shield
stat.infinitestats.armor.desc: Increases base armor, reducing incoming damage
stat.infinitestats.armor_penetration.des: Bypass a portion of the target's armor
stat.infinitestats.armor_toughness.desc: Increases armor toughness against high-damage attacks
stat.infinitestats.attack_speed.desc: Increases attack speed, reducing attack interval
stat.infinitestats.auto_smelt.desc: Automatically smelt ores when mined (e.g. iron ore → iron ingot)
stat.infinitestats.auto_step.desc: Automatically step up 1-block heights without jumping (stacks with Step Height)
stat.infinitestats.block_chance.desc: Chance to completely block an incoming attack
stat.infinitestats.crit_chance.desc: Chance to deal a critical strike on full-charge attacks
stat.infinitestats.crit_damage.desc: Extra damage multiplier on critical strikes
stat.infinitestats.damage_reduction.desc: Percentage-based reduction to all damage taken
stat.infinitestats.damage_reflection.des: Reflect a portion of incoming damage back to the attacker
stat.infinitestats.dodge_chance.desc: Chance to completely dodge an incoming attack
stat.infinitestats.debuff_immunity.desc: Auto-removes all marked potion effects (supports both positive and negative effects)
stat.infinitestats.invincibility.desc: Toggle, immune to all damage and keeps health full
stat.infinitestats.double_loot.desc: Chance to double all mob drops
stat.infinitestats.execute.desc: Deals bonus damage based on missing HP to targets below 30% health
stat.infinitestats.explosion_immunity.de: Complete immunity to all explosion damage
stat.infinitestats.fire_immunity.desc: Complete immunity to all fire-type damage, auto-extinguish flames
stat.infinitestats.fly.desc: Gain creative-style flight (double-tap jump to toggle)
stat.infinitestats.invisibility.desc: Gain permanent invisibility, harder for mobs to detect you
stat.infinitestats.item_magnet.desc: Instantly collects nearby dropped items, range controlled by config magnetRange (default 10)
stat.infinitestats.knockback_resist.desc: Reduces knockback taken from enemy attacks
stat.infinitestats.life_steal.desc: Heal yourself for a percentage of damage dealt
stat.infinitestats.life_steal_aoe.desc: Damage nearby enemies and steal life from them
stat.infinitestats.infinite_arrows.desc: Unlocked at 5 points: draw and fire a bow or crossbow without carrying arrows, consuming nothing from your inventory
stat.infinitestats.loot_luck.desc: Increases chance of rare drops from mobs
stat.infinitestats.luck.desc: Increases base luck attribute, affecting loot and fishing quality
stat.infinitestats.night_vision.desc: Gain permanent night vision, see clearly in darkness
stat.infinitestats.no_fall_damage.desc: Complete immunity to all fall damage
stat.infinitestats.no_hunger.desc: Permanently full saturation, no need to eat
stat.infinitestats.no_invincibility_fram: Remove post-damage invincibility frames for faster combat
stat.infinitestats.projectile_damage.des: Increases damage dealt by arrows and other projectiles
stat.infinitestats.projectile_immunity.d: Complete immunity to arrows and other projectiles
stat.infinitestats.reach.desc: Increases attack and block placement reach distance
Complete immunity to in-wall suffocation damage
stat.infinitestats.crafting_bonus.desc: Chance to get an extra item when crafting
stat.infinitestats.time_accel.desc: Speeds up time flow around you: faster crop growth, smelting, spawners, etc.
stat.infinitestats.time_accel_radius.des: Expands the area of time acceleration (+1 block per point)
stat.infinitestats.cooldown_reduction.de: Reduces item cooldowns (-0.5% per point, up to -100%)
stat.infinitestats.bow_draw_speed.desc: Increases bow/crossbow/trident charging speed, +3.0% per point
stat.infinitestats.use_speed.desc: Speeds up eating/drinking/shielding & other item use, +2.0% per point
stat.infinitestats.auto_repair.desc: Toggle, auto-repairs all damaged items in inventory & equipment per second
stat.infinitestats.repair_amount.desc: Durability restored per repair tick, +1 durability/s per point
stat.infinitestats.fly_speed.desc: Increases creative flight speed (via flying_speed attribute)
stat.infinitestats.vein_miner.desc: Mine entire ore veins by breaking a single block
stat.infinitestats.xp_gain.desc: Increases experience gained from killing mobs
stat.infinitestats.projectile_tracking.d: Unlock to make your projectiles (arrows, snowballs, tridents, etc.) steer toward the nearest enemy. Only scans within a configurable radius (default 64 blocks, adjustable in config) for far better performance than unlimited-range tracking.
screen.infinitestats.item_editor.no_chan: No changes; original item data preserved
screen.infinitestats.item_editor.changed: Item changed or edit data is invalid. Nothing saved; reopen the editor
screen.infinitestats.item_editor.name: Display Name
screen.infinitestats.item_editor.nothing: Nothing to copy in this column
gui.infinitestats.furnace.title: Furnace Boost
gui.infinitestats.furnace.collect_tip: Collect the output and stored products. Anything that does not fit stays in storage.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.collected: Collected %s items; any overflow stays in storage
gui.infinitestats.furnace.collect_none: No products to collect, or inventory is full
gui.infinitestats.furnace.upgrade_unavai: Requires %s available points and a level below the maximum.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.state.idle: Waiting for input; heat is saved
gui.infinitestats.furnace.workflow_tip: Shift-click inventory materials to load; other types join the queue. Fuel goes to the fuel slot first. To make charcoal, place logs in the input or queue manually. Queue: %s/27 slots; products: %s/27 slots.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.bulk_tip: Left-click: one stack. Right-click: half, up to one stack. Shift-click: fill inventory.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.cost_tip: Spend %s points to increase furnace speed by 1 level
gui.infinitestats.furnace.refund_tip: Decrease speed by 1 level, refund %s points
gui.infinitestats.furnace.fuel_buffer_ti: Queue any material with a smelting recipe, including food, sand and logs. Materials load automatically in priority order. Esc returns to the furnace.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.product_buffer: Smelted products are stored here automatically. Use Collect to move them into your inventory. Esc returns to the furnace.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.rs_ore_tip: Pull smeltable materials from a connected storage network.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.rs_fuel_tip: Pull fuel from a connected storage network.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.rs_deposit_tip: Send stored products to a connected storage network.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.product_rs_dep: Send stored products to a connected storage network.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.ore_priority.h: Click ores on the right, in the ore buffer, or in your inventory to prioritize. Drag rows on the left to reorder, or use the arrow / remove buttons.
gui.infinitestats.furnace.ore_priority.e: Click ores on the right to add
gui.infinitestats.furnace.ore_priority_t: Set which ores are pulled into the furnace input first: higher entries are smelted sooner
gui.infinitestats.crafting.cost_tip: Spend %s points to increase crafting multiplier by 1 level (hold Shift for 10)
gui.infinitestats.crafting.refund_tip: Decrease multiplier by 1 level, refund %s points (hold Shift for 10)
gui.infinitestats.crossdim_on: Cross-Dimension Teleport active, click a target dimension to teleport
gui.infinitestats.crossdim_hint: Activate the 'Cross-Dimension Teleport' stat to use this feature
screen.infinitestats.emc.no_selection: Select a learned item to extract
screen.infinitestats.emc.hint: Drag items from inventory to the learn slot
screen.infinitestats.emc.hint2: Items will be consumed and converted to EMC
screen.infinitestats.emc.learn_slot_hint: Place items here to learn & convert to EMC
message.infinitestats.emc.no_emc_value: This item has no EMC value
config.infinitestats.emc.rate.tooltip: EMC loss ratio when learning items (0=no loss, 1=all lost)
stat.infinitestats.true_damage.desc: Deal bonus true damage based on attack damage, ignoring armor and damage reduction
stat.infinitestats.reduce_max_health.des: Each attack lowers the target's max health (1 per point, minimum 1 HP remains)
stat.infinitestats.scope_attack.desc: Attacks also hit nearby enemies for 50% damage (radius +0.3 per point)
stat.infinitestats.repulsion.desc: Continuously pushes nearby hostile mobs away (radius +0.5 per point)
stat.infinitestats.cross_dimension_telep: Enables /infstats crossdim to teleport across dimensions
Enables /infstats wp to save and teleport to fixed coordinates
stat.infinitestats.pe_auto_learn.desc: Automatically learn items to ProjectE knowledge base when acquired
stat.infinitestats.portable_crafting.des: Enables /infstats craft to open a portable crafting table anywhere
stat.infinitestats.portable_furnace.desc: Enables /infstats furnace to open a portable furnace anywhere
stat.infinitestats.portable_anvil.desc: Enables /infstats anvil to open a portable anvil anywhere (repair & rename, experience still applies)
gui.infinitestats.wp_fixed_hint: Activate 'Fixed Teleport' in the stats panel to manage waypoints
gui.infinitestats.wp_hint: Scroll to navigate · Press Y to toggle panel
